description: Let's clear something up  You probably know by now that foam rolling is a unique recovery method that professional athletes are using to optimize performance. Advanced - Thick PVC Pipe (Painful investment)  - The Advanced category is solely occupied by thick PVC pipe  It is super firm and will give you the absolute deepest massage. Often painfully  deep. The issues with PVC are that the hard plastic is slippery and will often  slide out from underneath you. This, plus the whole painful thing we mentioned.   The Raw Roller (Smartest investment)  - The best attributes of Medium Caliber hollow rollers and Thick PVC Pipe  We designed Quality hollow roller with a Thick PVC pipe core. features: Washing Soda, also known as Soda Ash, Sodium Carbonate, Soda Crystal, or "Soda Ash Activator" has been in use since 3500 BC. It is commonly used as a household cleaner, in tie-dying, making powdered soaps, softening water, and balancing water's PH. Also used to make non-powdered-soaps, paper, and glass.

It is a great all-around cleaner. It excels at cleaning silver, laundry, grout, sinks, stoves, and anything with a hard water stain, "stripping towels" or other laundry. Simply add a scoop to your laundry detergent to give it a boost.

When tie-dyeing or using any other kind of "fiber-reactive" dye Washing Soda (Soda Ash Activator) is needed and will ensure the dye bonds (activates) with the cloth/fiber. description: Hydrofera Blue is a simple, safe, effective and proven moist wound dressing.
